xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2372: bug(swarm): slot finishes (pan done) without writing statusOverrides — empty continue.json breaks durable completion detection

plan.title: bug(swarm): slot finishes (pan done) without writing statusOverrides — empty continue.json breaks durable completion detection
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Slot `pan done` persists completion only to the rebuildable runtime plane (agent state.json + runtime resolution) — no durable record write. Record writes themselves are non-atomic (plain writeFileSync) and corrupt records are silently replaced with fresh empty ones, destroying accumulated statusOverrides. Worse, post-migration the deacon's swarm coordinator reads/writes the WORKSPACE record (<workspace>/.pan/records/) while the merge path's statusOverrides mirror writes the CANONICAL record (${OVERDECK_HOME}/state/<project>/records/) — two different files, so merged items never read completed and finalization never fires. Finally, an alive-but-idle clean+ahead slot can never converge because classifyDurableReadySlot is only consulted for missing/vanished sessions and the default infer_completion mode 'nudge' never auto-infers. Net symptom: `[swarm] <issue> slot N running` every patrol forever, no finalize, no PR (PAN-2253 slot-1, PAN-2378 slots 1-2).
narratives.Proposal: Make slot completion a durable, verified, single-door write and make detection consume durable state: (0) fix the state-home key mismatch (resolveStateReadHomeSync keys by basename(project.path) while the state worktree is keyed by the projects.yaml key, so migrated projects silently resolve legacy — discovered live during this planning session); (1) atomic tmp+rename record writes with read-back verification and corrupt-sidecar preservation; (2) re-home getIssueRecordPathForWorkspace onto canonical migration-aware resolution so every swarm read/write converges on one record; (3) slot pan done writes a swarm.slotCompletions marker and verifies it by read-back, exiting non-zero on persist failure; (4) classifyInFlightSlots treats a matching marker as ready-to-merge in every liveness branch, clears it on merge/requeue, and surfaces unreadable records; (5) default swarm.infer_completion flips nudge→auto; (6) defaultIsSlotWorktreeClean uses the shared isStatePlaneOnlyStatus predicate. Full PRD with verified file:line references: drafts/pan-2372.md on overdeck-state.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to 'nudge'/'off' semantics when explicitly configured via config or PAN_SWARM_INFER_COMPLETION
- No change to verifyAndMergeSlot verification/merge mechanics
- defaultGetSlotBranchAheadCount unchanged: state-plane-only commits still count as ahead (hazard H4, deferred)
- No removal of the PAN-1919 legacy fold of workspace continue.json statusOverrides in buildIssueRecord
- No fix for why gpt-5.5 slot agents idle without running pan done (harness/prompt behavior)
- No automated cleanup of stray legacy <workspace>/.pan/records/ files (Doctor/Deacon already flag them)
- No changes to review/test/merge pipeline stages beyond swarm slot completion detection

autoDecisions.summary: Durable marker lives in the per-issue record (swarm.slotCompletions), not workspace continue.json
autoDecisions.rationale: The per-issue record on overdeck-state is the post-migration durable plane; continue.json is gitignored workspace runtime and is exactly the file that was found empty in the original incident.

autoDecisions.summary: Slot pan done does NOT write item statusOverrides 'completed'
autoDecisions.rationale: Item completion is owned by the merge path (applyTaskOperationToPlanFile type 'done'); pre-merge completion would let finalizeSwarmIssueIfComplete fire before the slot branch is merged.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the split-brain at the getIssueRecordPathForWorkspace chokepoint instead of editing ~10 call sites
autoDecisions.rationale: One read door / one write door per the single-source-of-truth tenet; a path-resolution fix converges all callers and keeps unmigrated projects on their legacy surface automatically.
Operator-endorsed as substrate-correct in docs/FLYWHEEL-STATE.md (PAN-2378/RUN-56 diagnosis attached to PAN-2372); nudge-first grace and verifyAndMergeSlot gating remain.
Codebase map already exists at code-owned .overdeck/context/codebase/; recreating legacy .pan/ paths post-migration is stray-writer behavior per STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY.

autoDecisions.summary: Folded the state-home key-mismatch fix into this issue instead of filing a sibling
autoDecisions.rationale: Discovered live during this planning session (the finalize PRD gate resolved legacy .pan/drafts on a migrated project); it is the same failure class — completion detection silently reading wrong/absent durable state — and rehome-workspace-record-door has no effect on migrated projects without it.

items.title: resolveStateReadHomeSync resolves the registered projects.yaml key, not path basename

expected_outputs: state-read-home tests pass including the key-mismatch case

narrative.Action: In src/lib/state-read-home.ts:21, resolveStateReadHomeSync defaults projectKey = basename(project.path), but the state worktree is keyed by the projects.yaml key (state-home.ts projectKey(), lines 69-74: listProjectsSync().find(p => resolve(p.config.path) === resolve(project.path))?.key ?? basename). Live evidence: this repo's key is 'panopticon-cli', basename is 'overdeck'; ~/.overdeck/state/panopticon-cli/migration-complete.json is valid but the sync resolver probes ~/.overdeck/state/overdeck/ and silently resolves legacy — so records, specs, drafts, auto-commit, and the pan plan finalize PRD gate all treat a MIGRATED project as unmigrated. Fix: export/reuse projectKey() from state-home.ts (do not duplicate the lookup) as the default key in resolveStateReadHomeSync; keep the explicit projectKey parameter winning when passed; keep basename as final fallback for unregistered projects. Verification sweep (hazard H7): after the fix, list files under workspaces/*/.pan/records/ and <projectRoot>/.pan/{records,drafts,specs,continues}/ newer than the migration marker and merge them into the canonical state home, recording what was reconciled. See PRD WI-0 (drafts/pan-2372.md on overdeck-state).

items.title: Given a project whose registered projects.yaml key differs from its path basename and a valid marker under the registered key, resolveStateReadHomeSync returns migrated: true with root ${OVERDECK_HOME}/state/<registeredKey>

Atomic + verified record writes with corrupt-sidecar preservation

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pan-dir/record.ts, extract a shared writeRecordFileAtomicSync(path, record) used by writeIssueRecordSync (line ~279) and writeIssueRecordForWorkspaceSync (line ~306): write JSON to `${path}.${pid}.${Date.now()}.tmp` in the same directory, renameSync into place, then read back and JSON.parse the renamed file (throw on failure). Model the temp-name pattern on writePlanFileAtomic (src/lib/vbrief/dag-cli.ts:101-106). Add preserveCorruptRecordSync(path): when the existing file is non-empty and fails JSON.parse, renameSync it to `${path}.corrupt-${Date.now()}` and console.warn before the fresh write. Keep the PAN-2466 preserveCloseOutSync guard unchanged. See PRD WI-1 (drafts/pan-2372.md on overdeck-state).

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pan-dir/record.ts, change getIssueRecordPathForWorkspace (line ~196) to resolve the owning project via resolveProjectForIssue(issueId) ?? getProjectConfigFromWorkspacePath(workspacePath) and, when resolved, return getIssueRecordPath(project, issueId) (canonical, migration-aware); keep join(workspacePath, '.pan', 'records', ...) only as the unresolvable-project fallback. In writeIssueRecordForWorkspaceSync, when the project resolved, also call queueIssueRecordCommit(project, issueId, path) so re-homed swarm writes are committed to overdeck-state like canonical writes. This converges all workspace-door callers (deacon-swarm.ts:216/580/587/702/893, deacon-swarm-record.ts, slot-reconcile.ts, recovery-trip.ts, swarm-failed-slot.ts, agent-gc.ts, label-reconciler.ts, src/cli/commands/db.ts) on one record without editing them. Decision rule: a migrated project resolves to ${OVERDECK_HOME}/state/<project>/records/; an unmigrated project resolves exactly where it does today. See PRD WI-2 and hazards H1/H2.

Given an unmigrated project, getIssueRecordPathForWorkspace returns the same <workspace>/.pan/records/<issue>.json path as before the change (proven by unit test)

Slot pan done writes and verifies a durable swarm.slotCompletions marker

narrative.Action: Add PanIssueSwarmSlotCompletion { slotIndex: number; itemId?: string; agentId: string; completedAt: string } and slotCompletions?: Record<string, PanIssueSwarmSlotCompletion> on PanIssueSwarmRecord (src/lib/pan-dir/record.ts:90-95). Add writeSwarmSlotCompletion(workspacePath, issueId, completion) and clearSwarmSlotCompletion(workspacePath, issueId, slotIndex) to src/lib/cloister/deacon-swarm-record.ts modeled exactly on writeSwarmFinalizedAt (lines 34-45), keying by String(slotIndex). In completeSlotWork (src/cli/commands/done.ts:438-472): FIRST write the marker { slotIndex, itemId: slot.slotItemId, agentId: slot.agentId, completedAt: now }, then read the record back via readIssueRecordForWorkspaceSync and confirm swarm.slotCompletions[String(slotIndex)] exists with matching agentId; on failure print a red error stating completion did NOT persist and process.exit(1) BEFORE any runtime-state writes; on success proceed with the existing agent-state/runtime-state/activity writes unchanged. Do NOT write item statusOverrides here (autoDecision 2). See PRD WI-3.

items.title: Given a slot-shaped pan done invocation, when completeSlotWork succeeds, then the per-issue record contains swarm.slotCompletions[String(slotIndex)] with the slot's itemId, agentId, and an ISO completedAt

Given the marker write or read-back verification fails (e.g. stubbed writer throws or record unreadable), when completeSlotWork runs, then it prints an error stating completion did not persist and exits with a non-zero code before touching runtime state
completeSlotWork writes the marker even when the slot agent's state.json is missing (agentState null), using the parsed agentId and slotIndex
completeSlotWork preserves record.statusOverrides byte-for-byte — it creates no item/subItem status entries (asserted by comparing statusOverrides before and after a slot pan done)
classifyInFlightSlots honors the durable marker; coordinator clears it on merge/requeue; unreadable records surfaced

metadata.readinessReason: Serialized after durable-slot-completion-marker (consumes its marker API and shares deacon-swarm-record.ts) and after the two completion-predicate beads (shared test files).

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/deacon-swarm.ts classifyInFlightSlots (359-466): add optional dep readSlotCompletion(workspacePath, issueId, slotIndex) (default: read record via the door, return swarm.slotCompletions[String(slotIndex)]). At the top of the per-slot loop — before the !slot.agentId branch and before getAgentRuntimeState — if a completion exists and (completion.itemId is absent or equals slot.itemId), push { ...slot, lifecycle: 'ready-to-merge', exitStatus: 0, signal: 'durable-completion' } and continue. In mergeReadySlots inside the result.merged branch (~511-523), call clearSwarmSlotCompletion(workspacePath, issueId, slot.slotIndex). In the requeue/supersede path (requeueFailedSwarmSlots / superseded-attempt recording), clear the requeued slot's marker. In defaultReadStatusOverrides (216-222), distinguish absent record (silent undefined) from unreadable record (file exists but read returns null/throws): console.warn '[swarm] record unreadable for <issue> — treating as no overrides; see .corrupt sidecar'. Use injected now/stallThresholdMs in tests (existing pattern); no wall-clock waits. See PRD WI-4 and hazard H3.

items.title: Given a durable marker whose itemId matches the slot, when classifyInFlightSlots runs with the session alive and idle, then the slot classifies ready-to-merge with signal 'durable-completion' and exitStatus 0
